run_post_http_request: run the post_http_request function to send embedding prompts to a vLLM API server
run_parse_args: run the parse_args function to parse CLI host and port arguments for the vLLM embedding client
run_main: run the main function to send embedding requests with bytes and bytes_only encoding formats to a vLLM server
build_build_metadata_items: build metadata items for bytes_only encoding format with specified dtype, endianness, shape, and request count
decode_decode_pooling_output: decode pooling output from raw bytes body and metadata items into embedding tensors
